description.zh: 把经历写成让招聘方愿意约面试的简历：挖掘并量化成果，对照岗位描述检查关键词覆盖和学历年限要求，体检简历常见问题，导出 3 种版式的 Word 简历，再准备自我介绍和行为面试回答。不编造经历和数据。
description.en: Turns your experience into a resume that gets interviews: quantifies achievements, checks keyword coverage against job descriptions, flags common issues, exports Word resumes in three layouts, and prepares self-introductions and behavioral answers. Never fabricates.

welcome_message.zh: 把你的简历和想投的岗位描述发给我
welcome_message.en: Send me your resume and the job description you're targeting

prompt.zh: 这是我的简历 ___，目标岗位是 ___，帮我逐条优化。
prompt.en: Here's my resume ___. Target role: ___. Improve it line by line.

prompt.zh: 这是岗位描述 ___，看看我的简历还缺哪些关键要求。
prompt.en: Here's the job description ___. What key requirements is my resume missing?

prompt.zh: 我没有简历，___ 年 ___ 经验，想投 ___，帮我写一份。
prompt.en: I have no resume, ___ years in ___, targeting ___. Help me write one.

prompt.zh: 把简历导出成 Word，用 ___（经典/现代/紧凑）版式，控制在一页。
prompt.en: Export my resume to Word in the ___ (classic/modern/compact) layout, one page.

prompt.zh: 根据我的简历和 ___ 岗位，写一个 1 分钟自我介绍。
prompt.en: Write a 1-minute self-introduction for the ___ role based on my resume.

prompt.zh: 模拟 ___ 岗位的面试，一次问我一个问题，回答后给反馈。
prompt.en: Run a mock interview for ___. Ask one question at a time and give feedback.

zh: 每周一「09:00」整理本周要投递的岗位，针对每个 JD 生成匹配报告
每天「20:00」汇总今天的投递记录和面试进展
面试前一天「19:00」根据岗位和简历生成可能的面试问题
每周五「18:00」复盘本周面试，更新简历中被追问较多的条目
每月 1 日「10:00」根据新完成的项目更新简历
每季度第一天「10:00」检查简历时间线和技能栏是否需要更新
en: Every Monday at 09:00, list this week's target roles and run a JD match for each
Every day at 20:00, summarize today's applications and interview progress
The day before an interview at 19:00, prepare likely questions for that role
Every Friday at 18:00, review this week's interviews and refine resume items that drew questions
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, update the resume with newly completed projects
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, check the timeline and skills section
